Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you in, it's hard to avoid the crowd control that follows, so keep your distance. If the shark shadow from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive appears beneath you, retreat toward an ally or turret. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move to the side of the path he came from to avoid the stun.
Pyke.fight: When Pyke steps forward and your allied marksman can land basic attacks, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing. After dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, look for an angle to catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, create distance.
Pyke.combo: After Pyke E Phantom Undertow is down, knock him up with Nami R Tidal Wave. Confirm the hit, then cast Nami Q Aqua Prison at his landing point.
Pyke.escape: Dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side gives you a chance to counter with Nami Q Aqua Prison. If Pyke R Death From Below is also on cooldown, engage with Nami Q Aqua Prison followed by Nami R Tidal Wave before it becomes available again.
Pyke.build: Build health first so you stay above the threshold for Pyke R Death From Below. To defend against Pyke's damage, build armor rather than magic resistance.
Pyke.laning: Save Nami W Ebb and Flow for when an ally's health is in danger. During a fight, use it at an angle that passes through both an ally and Pyke. While Nami Q Aqua Prison is down, don't push the lane; keep your distance. Check Pyke's stealth engage routes with a Control Ward, and don't enter a brush you have no vision of alone.
Pyke.phase: Even in the late game, Nami is easy to catch if she stands in front, so move behind your allies.
Pyke.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on them, and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Pyke engages, interrupt him with Nami R Tidal Wave, then follow up with Nami Q Aqua Prison at the spot where he is knocked up. Avoid standing beside low-health allies to reduce the chance of being hit together by Pyke R Death From Below or of Pyke chaining executions.

Senna.build: Build armor first to withstand Senna’s main damage. Senna P Absolution adds damage to her basic attacks based on the target’s current health, so do not stack health alone; build armor too. If allies are often rooted by Senna W Last Embrace, cleanse them with Mikael’s Blessing.
Senna.combo: For trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can land a basic attack, and throw Nami Q Aqua Prison when Senna steps forward to collect a soul or starts her last-hit animation. If you engage with Nami R Tidal Wave, confirm it hits, then chain Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point.
Senna.escape: Look to engage after Senna W Last Embrace misses or is down. Senna E Curse of the Black Mist increases her movement speed, but she has no ability to create distance on her own, so if you have closed the gap, catch her with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. If you are marked by Senna W Last Embrace, do not engage; move away from allies.
Senna.fight: Look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Senna steps forward to collect a soul. If your allied marksman is in a position to attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing once the trade starts, and use Nami W Ebb and Flow from an angle that hits both your ally and Senna.
Senna.laning: Watch where souls appear and harass Senna when she steps forward to disrupt her collection. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, keep your distance, and save Nami W Ebb and Flow’s mana for when an ally’s health is in danger.
Senna.phase: In the late game, Senna’s range and attack damage grow with the Mist she collects, so Nami should stay behind allies and focus on healing and empowering them rather than standing in front.
Senna.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, back off and move to an area where you have vision, or cast Nami R Tidal Wave into the mist to deny an engage angle. Prioritize using Nami R Tidal Wave to stop enemy engages, and if it hits, chain Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions in a straight line, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Senna W Last Embrace takes time to root after hitting, so dodge it from behind minions, and immediately move away from allies if you are marked. If Senna hits you once, back off so she cannot land a second attack and collect Mist.

Hwei.phase: Early on, Nami is weak because she has few ways to intervene, so maintain the lane with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Even late game, Nami has very low health, so don't stand in front; support your allies from behind.
Hwei.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Hwei's damage is mainly magic, and Nami has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If an ally is often caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment's crowd control, free them with Mikael's Blessing.
Hwei.combo: To start a fight, wait until Nami R Tidal Wave hits, then overlap Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point to chain a stun. In lane, if your ally can attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on them. When Hwei steps forward to get hit, throw Nami Q Aqua Prison, then add Nami W Ebb and Flow while he is stunned.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no ability to create distance on his own, so the moment Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your window to close the gap. Catch him then with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, wait, since its root or forced movement can interrupt your engage.
Hwei.fight: Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear is an opportunity to engage. If your allied marksman is in a position to actually attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing after the fight starts, and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when the enemy steps forward. Don't lead the engage while Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available.
Hwei.laning: Sustain through the lane with Nami W Ebb and Flow, and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Hwei steps forward. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses or is down, don't push the wave; keep your distance. Don't force your way through paths containing Hwei's placed zones or eyes, and check the area before entering brush without vision.
Hwei.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and keep healing with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, don't lead the engage. Prioritize using Nami R Tidal Wave to interrupt the enemy's engage. If an ally is caught by Hwei's crowd control, free them with Mikael's Blessing.
Hwei.watch: If you are caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment's root or pull, you are likely to get hit by follow-up attacks too. If Hwei's first ability hits you, reposition immediately to avoid his second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't stay in its telegraphed area.

Alistar.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to interrupt Alistar's engage. Alistar R Unbreakable Will removes existing crowd control when activated, but Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave that hit him afterward still apply normally. While Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't spend damage on him; back off, and when you can fight, target the damage dealers behind him.
Alistar.laning: Use Nami W Ebb and Flow to keep health up, but conserve mana early in case an ally's health becomes critical. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, don't push the wave while you have no way to intervene; keep your distance. Check the enemy's location before entering a river or brush without vision.
Alistar.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Alistar's main damage is magic, and Nami has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Alistar.combo: To interrupt or counter Alistar's engage, confirm that Nami R Tidal Wave hits, then cast Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point to chain a stun after the knockup. For a lane trade, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your allied marksman, throw Nami Q Aqua Prison when Alistar steps forward to get hit, then add Nami W Ebb and Flow while he is stunned.
Alistar.escape: Alistar W Headbutt is his mobility, so the moment it is down is your window to close the gap or counterattack. If Alistar Q Pulverize is down too, use that time to reposition, then hit Alistar with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave so he can't get away.
Alistar.fight: As soon as Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down, reposition and look for a trade. Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can actually land basic attacks, and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Alistar steps forward. When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off instead of spending abilities on him, then fight again after it ends.
Alistar.phase: Even late game, Nami is easy to catch if she stands in front, so fight behind your allied marksman.
Alistar.watch: If Alistar closes the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, he can follow up with the knockup from Alistar Q Pulverize and the stun from Alistar E Trample. Nami has no ability to escape on her own, so stay outside the range of Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize. Near a turret, don't leave Alistar room to circle behind you.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up after hitting something, making it easier to root allies behind the first target, so don’t stand on top of each other. If Neeko approaches while disguised, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may not be visible, so spread out as soon as a suspicious enemy gets close. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; watch the real Neeko’s position instead.
Neeko.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Neeko's main damage is magic and Nami tends to have low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If an ally is at risk after being caught in Neeko's crowd control, use Mikael's Blessing to free them.
Neeko.combo: When Neeko steps forward and your allied marksman can reach her with attacks, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing. Throw Nami Q Aqua Prison the moment Neeko's movement is restricted. If you start with Nami R Tidal Wave, confirm the hit, then overlap Nami Q Aqua Prison at her landing point.
Neeko.escape: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is your chance to close in and trade. Don't follow the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; confirm which one is the real Neeko before using your abilities.
Neeko.fight: Fight when Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down or while Neeko R Pop Blossom is unavailable. Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can actually land basic attacks, and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison as Neeko steps forward.
Neeko.laning: While Nami Q Aqua Prison is down, don't push the lane, and spread out so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can't catch multiple allies. Check Neeko's position before entering a brush you have no vision of.
Neeko.phase: In the late game, even though Nami's healing and buffs become stronger, her health is still low, so don't stand in front.
Neeko.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on them, and help them recover with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Stay spread out from allies in case Neeko approaches while disguised, so you aren't all caught by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom. If Neeko engages, interrupt her with Nami R Tidal Wave. Confirm the hit, then cast Nami Q Aqua Prison at her landing point.

Ashe.combo: When Ashe steps forward and your ally can land basic attacks, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your ally, stun Ashe with Nami Q Aqua Prison, then add Nami W Ebb and Flow. Aim Nami W Ebb and Flow so it passes through both your ally and Ashe to get the heal and damage. If you start with Nami R Tidal Wave, confirm it hits, then cast Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point.
Ashe.escape: Go in just after Ashe W Volley is down, when Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended. Ashe has no way to create distance on her own, so if you close the gap, catch her with Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave.
Ashe.fight: Trade when Ashe W Volley is down and your allied marksman can land basic attacks. Once the fight starts, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your ally and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Ashe steps forward. While Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, create distance and engage again after it ends.
Ashe.laning: Early on, save Nami W Ebb and Flow for when an ally's health becomes critical and maintain the lane. Dodge Ashe W Volley to the side, then look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Ashe steps forward. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, keep your range and don't go alone into areas without vision.
Ashe.phase: Even late game, Nami is easy to catch if she stands in front, so support your team from behind your allied marksman.
Ashe.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to interrupt the enemy's engage, and follow up with Nami Q Aqua Prison if you get an angle to hit Ashe. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don't start a small skirmish from out of vision.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is a wide-area slow, so sidestep it and look for an opening right after it is down. Ashe P Frost Shot's slow refreshes with each basic attack, so don't stay within Ashe's basic attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don't start a small skirmish from out of vision; change direction when dodging the arrow.

Bard.build: Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Bard's main damage is magic, and Nami has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Also watch out for situations where Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns you and the enemy focuses you.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey is down, hit him with Nami R Tidal Wave. Confirm it hits, then overlap Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point. Time it so the stun follows as the knockup ends. For a lane trade, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your ally can basic attack, and when Bard steps forward, follow Nami Q Aqua Prison with Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Bard.escape: Right after you force Bard to use Bard E Magical Journey is your window to close the gap. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is down too, position so you can avoid the stun, then engage with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, don't overcommit to chasing while you have no way to intervene.
Bard.fight: When Bard steps forward and your allied marksman can land basic attacks, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing to start a trade. Throw Nami Q Aqua Prison when Bard starts an attack or is caught by another form of crowd control, then add Nami W Ebb and Flow while he is stunned. After Bard E Magical Journey is down, look for an angle to catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.
Bard.laning: Use Nami W Ebb and Flow to keep your allies healthy, and look for the moment Bard steps forward. If Bard W Caretaker's Shrine is visible in lane, walk over it to remove it. When Nami Q Aqua Prison is down, don't push the wave; keep your distance.
Bard.phase: Late game, Nami's healing and buffs become stronger, but she has low health, so fight behind your allies.
Bard.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and keep healing with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to interrupt Bard's team's engage or block the escape route of a fleeing enemy. Position away from walls and from straight lines through allies or minions to avoid Bard Q Cosmic Binding's stun.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns when it hits a wall or a second target, so don't stand with a wall behind you or in a line with an ally or minion. Watch for Bard E Magical Journey, which can bring him around your flank. Watch when Bard R Tempered Fate's damage immunity ends, then cast Nami Q Aqua Prison.

Blitzcrank.build: Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Blitzcrank's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Blitzcrank.combo: Time your abilities so the stun follows as the knockup ends. During a fight, if your ally can attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing to add a slow.
Blitzcrank.escape: Go in when Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or he is low on mana. When you get an angle to catch him, use Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own, so it's hard for him to get away once caught.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when he is low on mana. Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can actually land basic attacks. If the enemy steps forward, catch them with Nami Q Aqua Prison, then add Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Blitzcrank.laning: Don't stand level with the minions; always block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab from behind them. Use a Control Ward to secure brush vision, and when Nami Q Aqua Prison is down, keep your range and don't push the wave. After Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, gain an advantage by pushing the wave or trading.
Blitzcrank.phase: Early on, Nami is weak because she has only one way to intervene, so dodge Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab first. Once Nami W Ebb and Flow is available, sustain through the lane with its healing. Late game, Nami also has low health and is easy to catch if she stands in front, so fight behind your allies.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Blitzcrank engages, interrupt him with Nami R Tidal Wave, then follow up with Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point of the enemy hit.
Blitzcrank.watch: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls the first target it hits, so stand with minions in front of you. If you're pulled, Blitzcrank can follow up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank R Static Field, so keep your distance when walking near brush without vision.

Brand.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Brand's main damage and Brand P Blaze deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Brand.combo: For a lane trade, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your allied marksman when they can attack. When Brand steps forward to get hit, throw Nami Q Aqua Prison, then use Nami W Ebb and Flow while he is stunned.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so close the gap if the distance remains within range just after Brand uses W Pillar of Flame. If Brand P Blaze isn't applied, Brand Q Sear can't stun its target, so catch him then with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.
Brand.fight: Even after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, if Brand remains in range, that's an opening to engage. When a fight starts with your allied marksman in a position to actually attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, then catch Brand with Nami Q Aqua Prison when he steps forward and add Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Brand P Blaze is applied, dodge Brand Q Sear's path before closing the gap.
Brand.laning: Avoid standing next to minions Brand has set on fire, and throw Nami Q Aqua Prison when Brand steps forward or starts an attack to last-hit. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, keep your range and conserve mana for Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Brand.phase: Late game, even though Nami's healing and buffs become stronger, she has low health, so don't stand in front.
Brand.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Avoid Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm spreading by not standing next to an ally who is burning. Prioritize using Nami R Tidal Wave to interrupt the enemy's engage, then overlap Nami Q Aqua Prison at Brand's landing point after knocking him up.
Brand.watch: After Brand P Blaze is applied to you, getting hit by his next ability adds stacks and causes an explosion, so focus on dodging his initial abilities, Brand Q Sear and Brand W Pillar of Flame. While Blaze is applied, Brand Q Sear can stun you, so move out of its projectile path or stand behind minions. If you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, spread out from your allies, and move earlier if you are burning.

Braum.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to build magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Braum P Concussive Blows' stun and the knockup from Braum R Glacial Fissure are also dangerous for Nami, who has no mobility, so get tenacity.
Braum.combo: For a trade, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your ally is in a position to basic attack. When Braum steps forward, hit him with Nami Q Aqua Prison, then add Nami W Ebb and Flow while he is stunned. If you start with Nami R Tidal Wave, confirm it hits, then cast Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point to chain a stun after the knockup.
Braum.escape: Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is down is your window to engage with Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave.
Braum.fight: When Braum steps forward and your allied marksman can land basic attacks, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your ally and counter with Nami Q Aqua Prison. If Braum E Unbreakable is blocking the front, wait for his shield to drop or find an angle from the side. Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is down, look for a chance to catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave.
Braum.laning: Stay behind minions to avoid the straight-line angle of Braum Q Winter's Bite, and maintain the lane with Nami W Ebb and Flow. When Nami Q Aqua Prison misses or is down, don't push the wave; keep your distance. Nami W Ebb and Flow costs a lot of mana, so use it when an ally's health is critical or for a trade that can pass through both an ally and an enemy.
Braum.phase: Early on, Nami is weak because she has only one way to intervene, so don't give Braum a chance to start stacking his mark on you. Once Nami W Ebb and Flow is available, sustain through the lane. Late game, even though Nami's healing and buffs become stronger, she has low health, so don't stand in front.
Braum.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to interrupt Braum's engage. Don't pour damage into the direction Braum E Unbreakable is facing; wait for his shield to drop or for another angle to open. Avoid Braum R Glacial Fissure's line and lingering slow zone, and target the person he is protecting rather than Braum.
Braum.watch: Braum Q Winter's Bite only hits the first target, so stand behind minions. If Braum P Concussive Blows marks you, get out of range before the stun stacks build up. When you see Braum R Glacial Fissure's cast animation, sidestep out of its line, and don't walk through the lingering slow zone.

Heimerdinger.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Heimerdinger's main damage is magic, and Nami has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.combo: If your allied marksman is in a position to attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing. When Heimerdinger steps forward to get hit, throw Nami Q Aqua Prison, then add Nami W Ebb and Flow while he is stunned.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you've approached by going around his turret setup, catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don't keep trading in front of the turrets; look for an opening when Heimerdinger moves away from them or just after a turret fires a powerful shot. Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can land basic attacks, and catch Heimerdinger with Nami Q Aqua Prison when he steps forward.
Heimerdinger.laning: Save Nami W Ebb and Flow for when an ally's health becomes critical. During a trade, use it when it can pass through both an ally and an enemy. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, you'll have a window when you can't intervene, so don't push the wave during that time; keep your distance.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early on, Nami is weak because she has only one way to intervene, so avoid fighting in front of the turrets and maintain the lane with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Late game, Nami is also easy to catch if she stands in front, so support your allies from behind.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and help them recover with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to interrupt Heimerdinger's team's engage or block an escape route. While Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, don't group with allies in one spot.
Heimerdinger.watch: While Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, watch out for his empowered grenade and rockets; don't group with allies in narrow passages.

Janna.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Janna’s damage is mostly magic and Nami has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance if you’re adding resistances.
Janna.combo: When engaging, confirm Nami R Tidal Wave hits Janna, then throw Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point to chain a stun after the knock-up. Janna R Monsoon can push you out of your engage, so if possible, start the combo after she uses it. For lane trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can attack, then use Nami Q Aqua Prison when Janna steps forward, followed by Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Janna.escape: After Janna Q Howling Gale misses and you have avoided the knock-up, look for a chance to engage. If Janna R Monsoon is also down, she has fewer ways to push you out of an engage, so close the gap and land Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.
Janna.fight: After drawing out Janna E Eye Of The Storm, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can land basic attacks. Look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Janna steps forward to trade, then use Nami W Ebb and Flow at an angle that hits both an ally and an enemy while Janna is stunned. If Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon are down, that’s a chance to close the gap and land Nami’s crowd control.
Janna.laning: Pressure the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, but save Nami W Ebb and Flow for when your allies need health. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses or is down, don’t push the lane; keep a safe distance.
Janna.phase: Even late game, Nami has low health, so don’t stand in front; fight from behind your allies.
Janna.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Prioritize using Nami R Tidal Wave to stop an enemy engage. If Janna is separated from an allied damage dealer and is alone, look for a chance to catch her with Nami R Tidal Wave and Nami Q Aqua Prison. Focus damage on a target affected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm after the shield is gone.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks enemies airborne, so if you hear its tornado from a brush or outside vision, move out of its path. A target affected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm gains a shield and increased attack damage, so don’t focus damage on them while the shield is up. Janna R Monsoon knocks away enemies who engage, so don’t go in recklessly while she can use it.

Karma.build: Early on, withstand Karma’s magic damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Since Karma’s main damage is magic, prioritize magic resistance. If your allies are frequently caught by Karma’s root, free them with Mikael’s Blessing.
Karma.combo: During lane trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can attack, then throw Nami Q Aqua Prison when Karma steps forward to trade. While Karma is stunned, use Nami W Ebb and Flow, choosing an angle that bounces between an ally and Karma to get both healing and damage.
Karma.escape: If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, she can catch you if you engage first, so create distance and make her use W before going in. Also wait until the shield from Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra expires. Once you’ve closed the gap, catch Karma with Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave.
Karma.fight: Move behind minions or outside Karma Q Inner Flame’s range so you don’t take it for free and let Karma R Mantra come back sooner. When a trade begins and your allied marksman can land basic attacks, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing. If Karma steps forward, look for Nami Q Aqua Prison. Delay your engage right after Karma’s E shield empowered by Karma R Mantra comes up, and fight after the shield expires.
Karma.laning: If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, don’t push the lane while you have no way to intervene; stay at range. Don’t enter a brush you have no vision of first; check the area before moving in.
Karma.phase: Even late game, Nami is easy to catch if she stands in front, so stay behind your allies and focus on healing and empowering them.
Karma.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. While Karma W Focused Resolve is available, your allies’ engage can be interrupted, so go in after W is down and focus damage after the shield from Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra expires. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop an enemy engage or block their escape, then catch them with Nami Q Aqua Prison.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows in an area, making it harder to close the gap, and the zone left by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra detonates again after a short delay. If hit, leave the circle immediately. If tethered by Karma W Focused Resolve or Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra, create distance before the root lands.

Leona.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Leona’s damage is mostly magic, so prioritize magic resistance, but also consider the damage type of the enemy carry who will hit you while Leona has you caught. If your allies are repeatedly locked down by crowd control, free them with Mikael’s Blessing.
Leona.combo: When Leona E Zenith Blade is down and your allied marksman can attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your ally. Throw Nami Q Aqua Prison when Leona steps forward, then use Nami W Ebb and Flow while she is stunned. If starting with Nami R Tidal Wave, confirm it hits, then place Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point.
Leona.escape: Immediately after you make Leona use her mobility tool, Leona E Zenith Blade, is your window to close the gap and engage. If Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave hits then, Leona will have a hard time escaping. If Leona still has crowd control, keep your distance, since Nami has no built-in escape.
Leona.fight: Don’t let Leona get close before Leona E Zenith Blade is down. After Leona engages, counter with Nami Q Aqua Prison, and cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can actually attack. Use Nami W Ebb and Flow during a trade when it can bounce between an ally and an enemy.
Leona.laning: Don’t rush physical damage trades against Leona’s high early armor; counterattack after her engage ability is down. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, stay at range and don’t push the lane.
Leona.phase: Even late game, Nami has low health and is easy to catch if she stands in front, so stay behind your allies.
Leona.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Leona engages, it’s safer to stop her with Nami R Tidal Wave; use Nami Q Aqua Prison after other crowd control lands. If Leona P Sunlight marks you, that signals follow-up damage is coming, so back away immediately.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and pulls her to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a line with your allied marksman. Leona Q Shield of Daybreak can be activated before she approaches, so dodge based on distance rather than whether she has used the ability. When the marker for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the center stun.

Lulu.build: Early on, withstand the damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Lulu’s damage is mostly magic and Nami has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Lulu.combo: For lane trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your allied marksman, then throw Nami Q Aqua Prison when the opponent steps forward to trade and use Nami W Ebb and Flow while they’re stunned. Use Nami W Ebb and Flow at an angle that bounces between an ally and an enemy. When engaging, confirm Nami R Tidal Wave hits, then place Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point.
Lulu.escape: The window to engage is after Lulu uses Lulu W Whimsy on another ally. Lulu has no dash to get herself out, so if you’ve closed the gap, catch her with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. Nami also has no ability to escape on her own, so keep your distance while Lulu W Whimsy is available.
Lulu.fight: Close the gap and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison after Lulu uses Lulu W Whimsy on another ally. During trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can actually attack, then catch the opponent with Nami Q Aqua Prison as they step forward. If Lulu’s shield is on an allied carry, that’s a chance to target Lulu herself.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the extra damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, and save Nami W Ebb and Flow for when your allies need health. Keep pressuring Lulu and her lane partner, but throw Nami Q Aqua Prison when an opponent is going for a last hit or steps forward. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, stay at range and don’t push the lane.
Lulu.phase: Nami is weak early, with only one way to intervene; once Nami W Ebb and Flow is available, use its healing to sustain in lane. Late game, even though Nami’s healing and empowerment become much stronger, she still has low health, so don’t stand in front.
Lulu.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing during fights from behind your allied marksman, and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop an enemy engage or block their escape, then place Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point after it hits. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, don’t focus only on targets it can save; consider Lulu herself or another target.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy silences you and prevents you from attacking, so don’t engage first while it’s available. Lulu R Wild Growth saves its target and knocks up nearby enemies, so don’t press an attack assuming a kill is certain against a target Lulu can still save with R. Stand behind minions in lane to reduce the extra damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion.

Lux.build: Early on, withstand the damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Lux’s damage is mostly magic and Nami has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If you need a way to free allies caught by Lux Q Light Binding or similar abilities, choose Mikael’s Blessing.
Lux.combo: For a trade, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from a position where your ally can attack. When Lux steps forward, stun her with Nami Q Aqua Prison, then follow with Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Lux.escape: The moment after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to close the gap. Lux has no mobility or ability to create distance on her own, so if you get close, catch her with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.
Lux.fight: Bait out Lux Q Light Binding and dodge it, then look for Lux as she steps forward. Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can land basic attacks, and throw Nami Q Aqua Prison when Lux steps forward to trade.
Lux.laning: Stand spread out beside your allies so Lux Q Light Binding can’t root both of you. Sustain with Nami W Ebb and Flow, but conserve mana early and use it when an ally’s health is dangerously low or when you can hit both an ally and Lux. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses and is down, don’t push the lane; stay at range.
Lux.phase: Even late game, Nami has very low health, so don’t stand in front; support with healing and empowerment from behind your allies.
Lux.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Don’t approach grouped with your allies, so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t catch you all in the same area. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop an enemy engage or block their escape, and if Lux is knocked airborne, chain Nami Q Aqua Prison at her landing point.
Lux.watch: Lux Q Light Binding roots up to the first two enemies hit, so don’t stand in a line with an ally. Move out of the area where Lux E Lucent Singularity lands, and dodge sideways when Lux R Final Spark’s red targeting line appears. If hit by Lux’s abilities, move out of basic attack range to avoid the extra damage from Lux P Illumination.

Maokai.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Maokai’s main damage, and consider tenacity in situations where roots chain together. If an ally is at risk while caught by crowd control, free them with Mikael’s Blessing.
Maokai.combo: During trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can land basic attacks. If the opponent steps forward, throw Nami Q Aqua Prison and use Nami W Ebb and Flow while they’re stunned. If starting with Nami R Tidal Wave, confirm it hits, then place Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point.
Maokai.escape: Immediately after you make Maokai use Maokai W Twisted Advance is your window to move in. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp is also down, you have less reason to keep your distance out of concern for being rooted. Catch him then with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave, and help the chase with the slow from Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing.
Maokai.fight: Close the gap and trade right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down. Hitting Maokai with abilities repeatedly makes his healing come back quickly, so focus poke abilities on the enemy carry.
Maokai.laning: Sustain with Nami W Ebb and Flow, but conserve mana early until an ally’s health is dangerously low. While Nami Q Aqua Prison is down, don’t push the lane; keep your distance. Maokai E Sapling Toss may be in a brush you have no vision of, so check the area before entering.
Maokai.phase: Even late game, Nami has low health and no ability to escape, so fight from behind your allies.
Maokai.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Maokai engages, stop him with Nami R Tidal Wave, then throw Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point after it hits. Take fights in open terrain so there’s room to dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance catches Nami and closes the gap, so while it’s available, don’t give him range near a brush. Maokai E Sapling Toss planted in a brush creates a bigger explosion, so be careful when engaging; if a sapling chases you, lead it toward minions or monsters instead of allies. Maokai R Nature's Grasp roots you for longer when it comes from far away, so dodge perpendicular to its path.

Milio.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Milio P Fired Up! and Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick deal magic damage, so build magic resistance. Decide on further resistance based on the enemy carry’s damage type as well, and get anti-healing earlier if Milio’s healing becomes a problem.
Milio.combo: After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, use Nami R Tidal Wave to knock the target up, confirm it hits, then throw Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point. Chain the stun as the knock-up ends, keeping in mind that Milio R Breath of Life can remove the stun if it’s available. For lane trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your allied marksman, use Nami Q Aqua Prison when the opponent steps forward to trade, then Nami W Ebb and Flow while they’re stunned.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only way to get out, so the moment after he uses it is your window to close the gap. If you reach him, catch him with the knock-up from Nami R Tidal Wave or the stun from Nami Q Aqua Prison. Even if Milio R Breath of Life is available, it cannot remove the knock-up from Nami R Tidal Wave.
Milio.fight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can actually land basic attacks, and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when the opponent steps forward. If the stun lands, bounce Nami W Ebb and Flow between an ally and an enemy to get both healing and damage. If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, that’s a chance to close the gap and target Milio himself.
Milio.laning: Nami W Ebb and Flow costs a lot of mana, so save it for when your allies need health, and during trades use it at an angle that hits both an ally and an enemy. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, don’t push the lane while it’s down; stay at range.
Milio.phase: Even late game, Nami has low health, so don’t stand in front; fight from behind your allies.
Milio.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, and help heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop an enemy engage or block their escape, and the knock-up remains even if Milio R Breath of Life is available. If you get an angle to approach Milio, target him with Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks away and slows the first enemy it hits, so check whether it is down before approaching him. When Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and increases the enemy marksman’s range, delay front-line engagements for its duration. Milio R Breath of Life can remove the stun from Nami Q Aqua Prison, but it cannot remove the knock-up from Nami R Tidal Wave.

Morgana.build: Early on, withstand Morgana’s magic damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If Morgana Q Dark Binding or Morgana R Soul Shackles can catch your allies, free them with Mikael’s Blessing.
Morgana.combo: If Morgana E Black Shield is down, land Nami R Tidal Wave first, confirm it hits, then throw Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point to chain the stun. For lane trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can attack; if the opponent steps forward, use Nami Q Aqua Prison followed by Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Morgana.escape: The opportunity to engage comes when Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap then and catch her with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.
Morgana.fight: Fight at range from behind minions so you can dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding. Don’t waste Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave on a target with Morgana E Black Shield; engage after the shield is down. When a trade begins, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your allied marksman if they can land basic attacks.
Morgana.laning: Protect your allies’ health with Nami W Ebb and Flow, and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Morgana steps forward. While Nami Q Aqua Prison is down after a miss, don’t push the lane; stay at range. Don’t enter an area without vision alone, and check enemy positions before entering a brush.
Morgana.phase: Even late game, Nami is easy to catch if she stands in front, so fight from behind your allies.
Morgana.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Morgana engages, stop her with Nami R Tidal Wave, but don’t waste crowd control on a target with Morgana E Black Shield. If an ally is caught, free them with Mikael’s Blessing.
Morgana.watch: Morgana Q Dark Binding catches the first target it hits, so dodge with a minion between you and her. If it hits, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks come next; the lower health is, the more damage the area deals, so don’t walk through it even when backing away. Morgana R Soul Shackles stuns after a delay, so if you see the chain, move out of range immediately.

Nautilus.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nautilus's main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance. If allies are often caught in crowd control, use Mikael's Blessing to free them.
Nautilus.combo: After Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, knock him up with Nami R Tidal Wave. Confirm the hit, then cast Nami Q Aqua Prison at his landing point to chain the stun. When trading in lane, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your ally can attack. If Nautilus steps forward, hit him with Nami Q Aqua Prison, then use Nami W Ebb and Flow while he is stunned.
Nautilus.escape: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down is your chance to engage; if it misses, you can trade safely during its cooldown. When retreating, get out of range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow's basic attack. Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on an ally who is pulling away from a pursuing Nautilus to use its slow and movement speed increase.
Nautilus.fight: Close the distance and trade right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. When your allied marksman can land basic attacks, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on them. If Nautilus steps forward, look for Nami Q Aqua Prison. While he is stunned, bounce Nami W Ebb and Flow between your ally and Nautilus to heal and deal damage.
Nautilus.laning: Stand with minions between you and Nautilus to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line. While Nami Q Aqua Prison is down after a miss, don't push the lane; keep your distance.
Nautilus.phase: Nami has few ways to respond early, and once Nautilus catches her, it's easy to be hit by chained crowd control, so keep your distance. In the mid and late game, Nami is still easy to catch if she stands in front, so fight behind your allies.
Nautilus.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on them, and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Nautilus engages, interrupt him with Nami R Tidal Wave, then chain a stun with Nami Q Aqua Prison after the knockup. When Nautilus has Nautilus R Depth Charge available, don't line up with allies along his engage path.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and kill setup, so keep minions between you and him to dodge it. Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots with his first basic attack, so after trading, don't stay within his attack range. Nautilus R Depth Charge follows its target and knocks up allies along its path, so don't stand overlapping with allies.

Pantheon.build: Consider armor items first to prepare for Pantheon's main damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on the target's maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Pantheon.combo: Confirm that Nami R Tidal Wave hits Pantheon, then cast Nami Q Aqua Prison at his landing point to chain a stun after the knockup. Then cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on an ally who can land basic attacks, and use Nami W Ebb and Flow to heal your ally and damage Pantheon.
Pantheon.escape: Your chance to engage is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. If only one of Pantheon's movement abilities is down, watch out for the other. While both are unavailable, lock him down with Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave.
Pantheon.fight: Stay out of Pantheon W Shield Vault's range, and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Pantheon steps forward. When a trade starts, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your allied marksman if they can land basic attacks, and use Nami W Ebb and Flow so it bounces through both your ally and Pantheon.
Pantheon.laning: Maintain health with Nami W Ebb and Flow while conserving mana. While Nami Q Aqua Prison is down after a miss, keep your distance and don't push the lane.
Pantheon.phase: In the late game, Pantheon's influence falls while Nami's healing and buffs grow stronger, but Nami's health is low, so don't stand in front.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on them, and keep their health up with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Pantheon engages, block his path with Nami R Tidal Wave, then chain a stun with Nami Q Aqua Prison after the knockup. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don't try to damage him from the front; wait for it to end or look for a flank.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns its target, so don't enter its range. When Pantheon uses Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke, keep minions between you and him. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its area.

Rakan.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rakan's damage is mainly magic and Nami tends to have low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Rakan.combo: When a fight starts in lane, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your allied marksman. If Rakan steps forward to attack, cast Nami Q Aqua Prison, then follow up with Nami W Ebb and Flow while he's stunned.
Rakan.escape: Right after dodging the landing of Rakan W Grand Entrance is your chance to close in or catch Rakan. Use Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave along his path. If Rakan is alone and separated from his allies, take advantage of the fact that Rakan E Battle Dance can't dash to an ally.
Rakan.fight: Look to trade right after Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield breaks. Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can actually attack, and cast Nami Q Aqua Prison if Rakan steps forward.
Rakan.laning: Nami has no mobility ability, so if Rakan catches her with his engage, it's easy to be hit by follow-up attacks; keep your distance first. Save Nami W Ebb and Flow for when an ally needs health, and when trading, use it at an angle that passes through both an ally and an enemy. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, don't push the lane; keep your distance until your ways to respond come back up.
Rakan.phase: Even when Nami's healing and buffs get stronger later on, she has low health and no mobility ability, so don't stand in front.
Rakan.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on them, and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Rakan engages, block his path with Nami R Tidal Wave, then cast Nami Q Aqua Prison at his landing point after the knockup. Don't stand in a line with allies so Rakan R The Quickness can't catch several of you together.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance knocks Nami up at its landing point, so step to the side when Rakan starts moving. Once Rakan R The Quickness is active, it's hard to escape on foot, so don't stand in a line; stop him with Nami R Tidal Wave or Nami Q Aqua Prison before he reaches you.

Rell.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rell's damage is mainly magic, so prioritize magic resistance.
Rell.combo: To start an engage, confirm that Nami R Tidal Wave hits Rell, then cast Nami Q Aqua Prison at her landing point to chain crowd control. When trading in lane, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can actually attack. If Rell steps forward, catch her with Nami Q Aqua Prison, then follow up with Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Rell.escape: Don't go in just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down; wait until Rell E Full Tilt is down too. Rell will have a hard time getting away if you hit her with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up.
Rell.fight: Poke Rell with magic damage from outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range. If Rell engages with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, create distance. Use Nami Q Aqua Prison when it can interrupt her engage.
Rell.laning: Manage your allies' health with Nami W Ebb and Flow while looking for the moment Rell steps forward. While Nami Q Aqua Prison is down after a miss, don't push the lane; keep your distance. Don't enter a brush you have no vision of alone.
Rell.phase: Even in the late game, Nami is easy to catch if she stands in front, so fight behind your allied marksman.
Rell.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on them, and help them recover with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Rell engages, block her path with Nami R Tidal Wave. Keep your distance from allies in advance so Rell R Magnet Storm can't pull several of you in together.
Rell.watch: If Rell and one ally speed up together with Rell E Full Tilt, that's a signal that she's about to engage, so stop trading and retreat out of range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Rell Q Shattering Strike comes in a straight line, so dodge to the side. Before a teamfight, keep your distance from allies so Rell R Magnet Storm can't pull several of you in.

Renata.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Renata Glasc's damage is mainly magic, so prioritize magic resistance. If allies are often caught in crowd control such as Renata Glasc Q Handshake, use Mikael's Blessing to free them.
Renata.combo: When trading, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your ally can land basic attacks. If Renata Glasc steps forward, stun her with Nami Q Aqua Prison, then follow up with Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Renata.escape: When Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, it's your chance to close in and target Renata Glasc herself. She has no mobility ability, so if you can get close, catch her with Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave.
Renata.fight: Trade when Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down and your allied marksman is in a position to attack. When the fight starts, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on an ally, and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison as Renata Glasc steps forward. If you can close the distance, focus Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave on Renata Glasc herself, since she has no mobility ability.
Renata.laning: Cast Nami Q Aqua Prison when Renata Glasc steps forward or is caught in other crowd control. If it misses, keep your distance and don't push the lane. Nami W Ebb and Flow costs a lot of mana, so don't waste it on poke; use it when an ally needs healing or at an angle that passes through both an ally and an enemy.
Renata.phase: Even in the late game, Nami has low health, so don't stand in front. Keep your distance from allies with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover in mind.
Renata.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, help them attack with Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, don't engage while grouped together; use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop the enemy engage. Right after an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout is taken down, retreat and protect your allies so that enemy doesn't revive through a takedown.
Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first target it hits, then can stun allies when it throws that target, so stand behind minions or your frontline. Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program travels in a straight line and deals damage and slows, so dodge to the side. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover hits you, you'll attack nearby allies, so keep your distance from them while R is available.

Seraphine.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Seraphine's damage is mainly magic and Nami tends to have low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If there is a lot of crowd control that immobilizes allies, use Mikael's Blessing to free those caught in it.
Seraphine.combo: When trading in lane, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can attack. If Seraphine steps forward into range to be hit, cast Nami Q Aqua Prison, then follow up with Nami W Ebb and Flow while she's stunned.
Seraphine.escape: Right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down is your chance to close the distance. Seraphine has no mobility ability, so catch her then with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. Conversely, if you're slowed, stop your engage and first get out of the straight line of Seraphine E Beat Drop.
Seraphine.fight: Trade when Seraphine is alone and separated from an allied marksman, or when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. If your allied marksman is in a position to land basic attacks, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison as Seraphine steps forward. While she is stunned, use Nami W Ebb and Flow to heal your ally and poke Seraphine.
Seraphine.laning: Nami W Ebb and Flow costs a lot of mana, so don't use it just to poke early on; save it for when an ally's health is in danger. Look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Seraphine steps forward, but if it misses or after you use it, keep your distance and don't push the lane. Nami has no mobility ability, so don't venture recklessly into brushes or the river when you have no vision there.
Seraphine.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, help them attack with Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Seraphine R Encore gains range as it passes through allied champions, so spread out to the sides. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop the enemy's engage, and if an ally is caught, free them with Mikael's Blessing.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you're slowed, move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine, and use Nami W Ebb and Flow or Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on an ally to increase their movement speed. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so don't stand in a line with your allies during teamfights.

Sona.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sona’s main damage is magic, and Nami’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Sona.combo: In lane, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can attack. When Sona steps forward, throw Nami Q Aqua Prison, then follow up with Nami W Ebb and Flow while she is stunned.
Sona.escape: After Sona R Crescendo is down, you have less need to spread out to avoid being stunned, so look to engage when Sona steps forward. Sona E Song of Celerity lets her escape with its movement speed, so decide whether to chase before it is activated, and catch her first with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.
Sona.fight: Trade when Sona steps forward to activate her aura. If your allied marksman can land a basic attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, then stun Sona with Nami Q Aqua Prison as she steps forward to be hit. Sona can escape with Sona E Song of Celerity, so prioritize a stun over a slow when trying to catch her.
Sona.laning: Sona has low health early and her abilities cost a lot of mana, so force trades when she steps forward. After Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, do not push the lane; keep your distance.
Sona.phase: In the late game, Sona P Power Chord’s growth stacks and repeated team healing make the matchup increasingly unfavorable over time, so Nami should fight from behind allies instead of standing in front.
Sona.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies so Sona R Crescendo does not stun you all together. Help from behind your allied marksman with Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing and Nami W Ebb and Flow, and use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop engages from Sona’s side or disrupt their positioning. Have your team build at least one Grievous Wounds item so Sona’s healing does not drag out teamfights.
Sona.watch: Sona P Power Chord empowers her next basic attack after she casts basic abilities several times, so create distance if Sona suddenly enters basic attack range. Sona R Crescendo stuns allies in a line, so spread out to either side and watch for Sona stepping forward.

Soraka.build: Survive first with a Null-Magic Mantle in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Soraka’s damage is mostly magic, and Nami’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first. If her healing makes trades drag on, consider Grievous Wounds next.
Soraka.combo: Chain a stun as the knock-up ends to reduce the time Soraka has to react. For lane trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on your allied marksman, then chain Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami W Ebb and Flow when the enemy steps forward.
Soraka.escape: The window to engage is right after Soraka E Equinox is used for poke or waveclear. Knock her up with Nami R Tidal Wave before stepping into the area, then chain a stun with Nami Q Aqua Prison. Soraka has no mobility ability, so once you close the gap, she has trouble escaping.
Soraka.fight: Look to engage once Soraka E Equinox is down. For trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can attack, and look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Soraka steps forward.
Soraka.laning: Dodge Soraka Q Starcall while pressuring the enemy marksman to make Soraka use Soraka W Astral Infusion. Soraka W Astral Infusion costs Soraka her own health, so the more you force her to heal, the more chances you get to target her. While Nami Q Aqua Prison is down, do not push the lane; keep your distance.
Soraka.phase: Nami is weak early because she has only one way to intervene, so do not overextend; sustain the lane with healing once Nami W Ebb and Flow is available. Nami also has low health in the late game and is easy to catch if she stands in front, so fight from behind allies.
Soraka.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and keep healing with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop enemy engages, then chain a stun with Nami Q Aqua Prison after it hits. If you can reach Soraka, target her first instead of continuing to attack the ally she is healing.
Soraka.watch: If Soraka hits you with Soraka Q Starcall, she heals and gains movement speed, so dodge it. Soraka E Equinox can silence and root you, so use your engage ability before stepping into its area. Keep Soraka R Wish in mind when looking for a kill, as it heals even across other lanes.

Swain.build: Swain’s damage is mostly magic, and Nami’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If allies are often caught by Swain E Nevermove, cleanse them with Mikael’s Blessing.
Swain.combo: For lane trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can attack, and when Swain steps forward to be hit, follow up with Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami W Ebb and Flow while he is stunned.
Swain.escape: Swain has no mobility or escape ability, so the window to engage is right after Swain E Nevermove is down. Do not go in after dodging only the first wave; confirm the return wave has disappeared too. Then catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.
Swain.fight: Start a fight right after Swain E Nevermove has fully been used. If your allied marksman is in a position to attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing once the fight starts, and catch Swain with Nami Q Aqua Prison when he steps forward. Avoid fights where you stay close to Swain and get hit by multiple bolts from Swain Q Death's Hand.
Swain.laning: Dodge the return path of Swain E Nevermove and keep your distance, then look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Swain steps forward. While Nami Q Aqua Prison misses or is down, do not push the lane; keep your distance.
Swain.phase: In the late game, Swain’s scaling and healing make extended fights unfavorable, so keep your distance and respond accordingly.
Swain.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, help them attack with Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, and heal them with Nami W Ebb and Flow. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move out of range and wait for it to end; use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop Swain’s engage. Apply Grievous Wounds when fighting again, and cleanse allies caught by Swain E Nevermove with Mikael’s Blessing.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and then returns, so after dodging the first wave, stay out of its path until it fully disappears. If rooted, you can be pulled in and hit by his combo, so use the movement speed from Nami P Surging Tides to keep your distance. Swain Q Death's Hand hits with more bolts overlapping at close range, so fight near its maximum range.

Taric.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Taric’s magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and build magic resistance before armor.
Taric.combo: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can land a basic attack. Stun Taric with Nami Q Aqua Prison when he steps forward, and while he is stunned, use Nami W Ebb and Flow so it passes through both your ally and the enemy. If you start with Nami R Tidal Wave, confirm it hits, then throw Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point.
Taric.escape: Look to engage after Taric E Dazzle is down. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. However, if Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity is active, do not unload your damage; wait for it to end.
Taric.fight: Immediately after dodging Taric E Dazzle, keep your distance and trade. Use the slow from Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing and the knock-up from Nami R Tidal Wave to keep Taric from reaching a target for a basic attack, which also prevents Taric P Bravado from reducing his ability cooldowns. Resume attacking once Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity ends.
Taric.laning: Avoid close trades early, protect your allies’ health with Nami W Ebb and Flow, and wait for Taric E Dazzle to be down. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, keep your distance and do not push the lane. Do not enter a bush without vision first; check the position before moving.
Taric.phase: Nami is easy to catch if she stands in front, even in the late game, so stay behind your allied marksman.
Taric.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and help heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. While Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity is active, hold the enemy with Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave so your team can continue attacking when the immunity ends. Prioritize using Nami R Tidal Wave to stop enemy engages.
Taric.watch: Taric E Dazzle has a delayed activation, so dodge to the side when you see its warning. The stun also activates from the position of an ally linked by Taric W Bastion, so keep your distance from both Taric and the linked ally. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop attacking and run out its duration by holding them with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.

Thresh.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Thresh’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance, but prioritize tenacity in preparation for being caught, since Nami has no mobility ability.
Thresh.combo: If your allied marksman is in a position to attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing. When Thresh steps forward to be hit, throw Nami Q Aqua Prison, then follow up with Nami W Ebb and Flow while he is stunned. If you start with Nami R Tidal Wave, confirm it hits, then chain the knock-up into a stun by overlapping Q at the landing point.
Thresh.escape: Close the gap right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence. If Thresh W Dark Passage has also been used and is still on cooldown, this is a chance to catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.
Thresh.fight: The moment after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the gap. Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can land a basic attack, and open the trade by catching Thresh with Nami Q Aqua Prison when he steps forward.
Thresh.laning: Save mana on Nami W Ebb and Flow and use it to heal when an ally’s health is in danger. Look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Thresh walks forward to collect souls, and after Q misses, keep your distance and do not push the lane. Do not enter a bush without vision alone.
Thresh.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. If Thresh engages, stop him with Nami R Tidal Wave, then look for Nami Q Aqua Prison on enemies while Thresh W Dark Passage is down. If caught in Thresh R The Box, immediately choose which wall to break through.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence leads to follow-up attacks if it hits, so move to the side and dodge when you see him raise his hook. Avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay does not pull you toward allies.

Velkoz.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Vel'Koz’s main ability damage, but keep moving to avoid being hit by abilities in succession, since resistance cannot block the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction or Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Velkoz.combo: To engage, wait until Nami R Tidal Wave hits Vel'Koz, then throw Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point to chain a stun after the knock-up. For trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your ally can land a basic attack, and when Vel'Koz steps forward, catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison followed by Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Velkoz.escape: The chance to go in comes right after dodging or baiting out Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Vel'Koz has no mobility ability, so close the gap during that window and catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. If you get very close, Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you back, so confirm it is down.
Velkoz.fight: If you close the gap after Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, you can catch Vel'Koz, who has no mobility ability, with Nami Q Aqua Prison. For lane trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can attack, and when Vel'Koz steps forward, chain Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Velkoz.laning: Early on, save Nami W Ebb and Flow’s mana and sustain with its healing, then look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Vel'Koz steps forward. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, you have limited means to intervene, so do not push the lane; keep your distance. Clear vision in the river and tri-brush to limit the positions where Vel'Koz can safely step forward to poke.
Velkoz.phase: In the mid game, once Nami R Tidal Wave is available, you can engage when Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down. In the late game, Nami’s healing and empowerment become much stronger, but she has low health and is easy to catch if she stands in front, so fight from behind allies.
Velkoz.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing from behind your allied marksman and keep healing with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Prioritize interrupting Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave once it starts. Also use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop enemy engages or block the escape route of a fleeing Vel'Koz.
Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission splits into two beams, so even if you dodge the main projectile, do not only sidestep; move behind where the beam passes. If hit by Vel'Koz W Void Rift and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption in succession, the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction will trigger, so create distance if you get stacks. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, interrupt the channel with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.

Xerath.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and build magic resistance to withstand Xerath’s magic damage.
Xerath.combo: To engage, wait until Nami R Tidal Wave hits Xerath, then throw Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing point to chain a stun after the knock-up. For lane trades, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing as soon as your allied marksman can attack, and when Xerath steps forward, stun him with Nami Q Aqua Prison before using Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the window to engage is right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Dodge to the side while Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse and close the gap; once near him, catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave.
Xerath.fight: Close the gap right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing when your allied marksman can actually attack, and when Xerath steps forward, catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison followed by Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Xerath.laning: Early on, avoid Xerath’s long-range poke, prioritizing high-damage hits, and save Nami W Ebb and Flow’s mana. If Nami Q Aqua Prison is down, keep your distance; when Xerath has spent a lot of mana, push the lane and call your jungler. Check positions before entering an area without vision.
Xerath.phase: Nami is easy to catch if she stands in front even in the late game, so fight from behind your allies.
Xerath.teamfight: Stand behind your allied marksman, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, and help heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to stop engages from Xerath’s side or block the escape route, and start dodging as soon as you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and dodge to the side. Be especially careful of Xerath E Shocking Orb, as its stun can set up follow-up damage. When you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, start moving to dodge immediately.

Zilean.build: Early on, stay alive with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Zilean deals magic damage, so build magic resistance, but tenacity has the more immediate impact when you’re caught by the bomb stun and slow.
Zilean.combo: If your allied marksman is in a position to attack, cast Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing. When Zilean steps forward to take a hit, throw Nami Q Aqua Prison. Follow up with Nami W Ebb and Flow during the stun to aim for both damage and healing.
Zilean.escape: When Zilean’s Q Time Bomb combo and Zilean E Time Warp are down, close the distance with your allies. Zilean has no mobility spell, so once you’re close, catch him with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. When retreating, cast Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing on an ally to slow pursuers.
Zilean.fight: After that, cast Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing when your allied marksman can actually attack, then look for Nami Q Aqua Prison when Zilean steps forward. During trades, use Nami W Ebb and Flow from a position where it can heal an ally and bounce to an enemy.
Zilean.laning: Nami W Ebb and Flow costs a lot of mana, so save it for when an ally’s health is in danger. While Nami Q Aqua Prison is down, don’t push the lane; keep your distance. Check Zilean’s position before entering a bush where you have no vision.
Zilean.phase: In the late game, Nami’s healing and buffs become stronger, but she is still fragile, so stay behind your allies and support them instead of standing in front.
Zilean.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow from behind your allied marksman. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to interrupt an enemy engage, and stay away from allies with Zilean Q Time Bomb attached so you aren’t stunned together. Don’t use abilities on a target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift while they revive; if they’re hard to finish off, target fragile Zilean instead.
Zilean.watch: Once Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches, move away from your allies and outside its blast radius. If Zilean E Time Warp slows you while you’re alone, you’re easy to hit with the bomb combo, so avoid engaging by yourself.

Zyra.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Zyra’s main damage is magic, and Nami has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance. If an ally is often rooted by Zyra E Grasping Roots, free them with Mikael’s Blessing.
Zyra.combo: For a lane trade, cast Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing on your allied marksman, throw Nami Q Aqua Prison when Zyra steps forward to take a hit, then follow up with Nami W Ebb and Flow during the stun. When starting with Nami R Tidal Wave, confirm it hits, then place Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing spot to chain a stun after the knock-up.
Zyra.escape: The moment after you dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots is an opportunity to close the distance. If there are no plants nearby either, catch Zyra with Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave. Don’t go in first while Zyra E Grasping Roots is available or where plants are gathered.
Zyra.fight: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots sideways, then close the distance while there are no plants nearby. When trading, cast Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing when your allied marksman can actually attack, and stun Zyra with Nami Q Aqua Prison when she steps forward. Use Nami W Ebb and Flow from an angle where it can pass through both an ally and Zyra.
Zyra.laning: If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, it’s hard to intervene, so look for a moment after you dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots or when Zyra starts her last-hit animation. Don’t enter brush where you lack vision first, and check areas where Zyra has stayed for a while, assuming her seeds are providing vision.
Zyra.phase: Even in the late game, Nami is easy to catch if she stands in front, so fight from behind your allies.
Zyra.teamfight: Cast Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing and heal with Nami W Ebb and Flow from behind your allied marksman. Don’t take a fight in an area where Zyra has built up plants; move the fight elsewhere. Use Nami R Tidal Wave to interrupt an enemy engage, then follow up with Nami Q Aqua Prison at the landing spot of a knocked-up enemy.
Zyra.watch: If you’re rooted by Zyra E Grasping Roots, plant damage and the knock-up from Zyra R Stranglethorns can follow. Move sideways at the edge of its range to dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots, and walk out of range when you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns. Don’t fight where there are many plants; back off briefly.
